_comment: Teaching fixture: a simplified instruction<->account graph in the shape Gecko's comprehension produces for a small storefront program. Provenance tiers: declared (IDL), recovered (program source), measured (execution on a fork), inferred (heuristic).

instructions.name: initialize_store
instructions.summary: Create the store account that later purchases read.

instructions.name: list_item
instructions.summary: Add an item with a price and a mint to an existing store.

accounts.name: item
accounts.note: seed order recovered from program source; the IDL omits item_index

instructions.name: purchase
instructions.summary: Buy one item: moves lamports to the store authority and mints/transfers the item token to the buyer.

accounts.name: buyer_token_account
accounts.note: associated token account; mint must be read from the item account first

accounts.name: mint
accounts.note: confirmed by executing purchase on a fork and observing the token movement

intents.intent: buy a coffee / purchase an item
